currentWork.title: FINAL.36 route sanity, natural HGV selection, and fluorescent route visibility
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #170 and awaits merge/production verification. FINAL.35 remains the current production release until merge.
fieldEvidence: Operator reports some routes take unnecessary detours that do not appear related to highway preference.
Operator also reports highway ON can still miss plausible expressway use.
Ordinary blue route line is difficult to distinguish from the base map.
scope: Initial routing accepts cached GPS only when <=5 seconds old and <=50m accuracy; otherwise it requests a fresh high-accuracy fix with maximumAge=0 and rejects fixes worse than 50m.
Automatic reroute uses the median of the three sustained accurate off-route fixes rather than the final single fix.
Automatic reroute keeps the existing route when the replacement distance is an extreme detour versus remaining route plus reconnect distance.
ORS remains driving-hgv with all registered dimensions/weight restrictions, but base preference changes from fastest to recommended to reduce time-only distance detours.
Highway ON alternatives become more diverse (share_factor 0.85, weight_factor 1.6); admissible detour limits are tightened and expressway distance is maximized only among near-fast candidates.
Ordinary route rendering becomes fluorescent cyan (#00e5ff) over a dark casing; motorway/toll remains red over the same casing.
No car routing, straight-line fallback, or weakening of HGV restrictions is introduced.
